items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Chu Choo Berry was a great influence on us getting a lot of fresh music into that band? Oh, yes. Oh, yes.

ctx.x: I remember, too, when -- we had a lot of good guys come through there. And I think Chu Choo Berry, would you agree with me that Chu Choo Berry was a great influence on us getting a lot of fresh music into that band?
